final_action.public_message: Gemini, not touching your developed sets: $120 cash for Mediterranean. You get double face value toward builds/unmortgaging; I get a modest brown project, not a board-wide threat.
final_action.private_thought: This is my most realistic monopoly path. Brown is weak but cheap, uses scarce houses, and Gemini needs cash for reds/oranges/light blues. If accepted, unmortgage Baltic and consider building; keep Boardwalk/Penn blockers.
